target_customer: IP law firms and in-house IP teams (trademark attorneys and patent attorneys), including enterprises such as Nestle per the company site
problem: Trademark clearance searches and patent drafting are slow manual attorney tasks. Edge applies AI to do task-sized work in seconds.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to law firms and enterprises (pricing not public)
product_category: Legal AI for intellectual property (trademark clearance and patent drafting)

founders.name: Evan Zimmerman
education: UC Berkeley Law, JD, IP focus (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC bio says every company he has done involved patents. CEO title per the Certus launch press release.

founders.name: Len Boyette
founders.background_notes: Early Okta engineer who founded its developer experience team, per YC page.

competitors.name: PatentPal
competitors.what: Generative AI startup for drafting patent applications
competitors.traction_then: Described as used by patent professionals

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on large language models in early 2023, so the hard parts were retrieval over trademark and patent data and attorney-grade accuracy rather than model research.

defensibility.rationale: Many rivals appeared quickly in patent drafting; the moat rests on workflow integration and law firm trust, with security certifications (SOC 2 Type II per site) as a sales aid.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources checked; the company remained independent and launched Certus and Ingenia.

market_need_then: Generative AI drew attention from patent practitioners in early 2023 (commentary on ChatGPT drafting), and attorneys bill heavily for search and drafting work.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B copy: 'Task-Based AI for IP'.

rebrands.why: Press says the patent product was newly renamed Ingenia, no reason given

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found only trade press about product launches and a podcast; the name Edge is generic and shared with many unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Edge is an active two-person-to-small-team legal AI company that has moved from a general IP assistant toward two named products, Certus for trademark and Ingenia for patents, with law firm and enterprise customers listed on its site. No funding or exit was found, and the patent drafting category drew many funded rivals later.
notes: No funding round found in two searches; coverage is none_found, not zero. One aggregator (CB Insights) says Edge was formerly Drift Bio, but the YC page for Drift Bio describes a different product, so unverified. Founding year 2020 is from the YC page. Later rivals (DeepIP, Solve Intelligence, IP Copilot) are not listed as competitors at founding. Trademark filing for CERTUS seen only on an aggregator.
